note: Reference data copied from the named sources as read on 2026-11-16. Tolerances were written before any comparison was run and must not be changed to make a case pass. The tolerances are the author's choice, not an industry standard.

tableCd.why: Applied Ballistics prints Cd to two decimals, so a match is within half a unit of the last printed digit.

velocityPct.why: Manufacturer tables print whole fps; 1% of about 2400 fps is about 24 fps.

dropIn.why: Larger of 2% or 0.3 in, since tables print drop to 0.1 in.

tablePoints.source: Applied Ballistics, ABDOC130 Drag Curve Models
tablePoints.quote: At Mach 3 (3348 fps) the G1 projectile has a drag coefficient of 0.51, while the G7 projectile has a drag coefficient of only 0.24.

tablePoints.source: Applied Ballistics, ABDOC130 Drag Curve Models

labelsConfirmed.confirmedBy: project owner, by viewing the page directly

trajectoryCases.valuePairing: Corrected 2026-11-16 19:04 by the project owner: the 50 yd column is a placeholder (0 / N/A / 0), and 2553 fps belongs to 100 yd. The triples were read from the page by a page-reading tool and the owner supplied the corrected pairing. The transcription the owner refers to was not seen by the author. Each row's energy is checked against its velocity in tests/validation.test.js as a transcription check; that check does not test ballistics. The pairing is the owner's, and has not been confirmed row by row against the page by the author.

A_shifted_one_column.reason: Used 2026-11-16 18:41 to 18:56. Paired 2553 fps with 50 yd, which shifted every row one column. The 50 yd column is a placeholder. Corrected by the project owner at 19:04.

B_hundred_yard_steps.reason: Discarded by the owner at 18:41 under the label '100-yard steps', before the 50 yd placeholder was identified. Its numbers are identical to the current mapping. The current mapping was adopted because the owner's page evidence (the placeholder 50 yd column) supports it, not because it matches the engine. Kept as history only.

ICAO.source: https://www.hornady.com/bc states BCs are corrected to the ICAO standard atmosphere (59 F, 29.92 inHg, 0% RH), as read by a summarizing page reader.

HORNADY_ABERDEEN.source: Hornady External Ballistics page quotes 'standard conditions for the Aberdeen test site': sea level, 59 F, 29.53 inHg, 78% RH, as read by a summarizing page reader.

atmosphereNote: Hornady's own pages disagree on which standard atmosphere its BCs use. Both are declared here before any dataset was run. Every dataset is run under each applicable atmosphere, both results are reported, and neither is selected as correct. STATED_CONDITIONS means the dataset's own printed conditions, used only where the source prints them.
preRegistration: Datasets, interpretations, atmospheres and tolerances below were written before the first run of tests/tools/run-validation.js on them (2026-11-16, after the 21:02 request). Tolerances are unchanged from the original three.

datasets.source: Hornady 300 Win Mag 200 gr ELD-X Precision Hunter, item 82002, Test Barrel (24 in) table
notPublished: barrel used for any real rifle
drag-model velocity banding (the app uses one BC)
datasets.note: Hornady's BC page (https://www.hornady.com/bc) lists the 30 cal 200 gr ELD-X at G1 0.597 / G7 0.301 for Mach 2.25 and above (2512 fps), G1 0.588 / G7 0.295 at Mach 2.0 (2232 fps) and G1 0.578 / G7 0.291 at Mach 1.75 (1953 fps), corrected to ICAO. This dataset uses the G1 band (Mach 2.25 and above). The table runs 2860 to 2140 fps, so the one-BC approximation spans two bands. Zero 200 yd is inferred, not stated: the published trajectory is +1.6 in at 100 yd and 0 at 200 yd; sight height 1.5 in from the -1.5 in muzzle row. The page's table text was read twice by a summarizing page reader and both reads gave the same 18 numbers in the same order; the row and column labels are the reader's inference from that order. Energy cells check against 200 gr and the printed velocities (E = m v^2 / 450240). Diameter .308 assumed for a 30 caliber bullet; the page does not print it. BC values were not on the product page and come from the BC page. Registered before the first run.

energyCheckExceptions.100: Printed energy 3253 ft-lb; 2707 fps at 200 gr gives 3255.1, a 2.1 ft-lb gap, just over the 2 ft-lb check (0.06%). Not corrected. Added after the first run, when the transcription check flagged it; it may be rounding in the printed velocity or a page-read slip. Only velocity and drop are compared, never energy, so it enters no comparison.

excludedSources.HORNADY-LE-CX-GMX-140-G1-0.350: Hornady LE pages hornadyle.com/rifle-ammunition/140-gr-cx-6.5-creedmoor and /140-gr-gmx-6.5-creedmoor (BC .350 G1). Not registered. Two reads of the same data disagreed on column placement (one dropped the 50 yd placeholder and shifted every column; the two reads also printed different SAAMI-row drops), and four of the five barrel rows have energies that imply 147 gr (for example 2685 fps and 2353 ft-lb), not 140 gr, so the rows cannot be trusted as read. Needs the raw page.
excludedSources.HORNADY-308-168-BTHP-MATCH: hornady.com/ammunition/rifle/308-win-168-gr-bthp-match. Not registered: the page text as read has no BC, so the drag model cannot be set. Its velocities and energies are consistent with 168 gr and a 200 yd zero.
excludedSources.FEDERAL-GM223M: Federal 223 Rem 69 gr page was not on the fetch allowlist.

roundNote: Round 1 datasets were registered 2026-11-16 before the 21:15 round was run. Round 2 datasets were registered 2026-11-16 after 21:44, before being run, from pages re-read that evening. Rounds are reported separately so the earlier counts do not move. Round 3 datasets (HORNADY-PH-300WM-200-ELDX-*) were registered 2026-11-17 before being run, to extend the compared weight range to 200 gr. Four BC variants of one table are registered together; all four are reported and none is selected. Tolerances are unchanged.
